name: Circulation coin
definition: Legal-tender coin struck for everyday circulation; a worn coin sold for its silver content (junk silver) is still this kind.

name: Circulating commemorative coin
definition: legal-tender coin with a commemorative design issued into circulation at face value.

name: Collector coin
definition: legal-tender coin issued for collectors, not circulation, including any coin struck in proof, reverse proof or another collector finish or issued in a mint's presentation packaging, even in gold.

name: Proof or mint set
definition: Set of coins issued and sold by a mint as one packaged product.

name: Emergency coin
definition: coin struck by an official authority in an emergency, such as a siege coin or official necessity coin.

name: Pattern or trial strike
definition: coin struck to test a design, die or metal and not issued for circulation.

name: Replica or counterfeit coin
definition: copy of a coin, a coin-like piece of an issue that never existed, or a contemporary counterfeit made to pass as money.

name: Circulation banknote
definition: banknote issued by a currency authority for everyday circulation.

name: Commemorative banknote
definition: banknote with a commemorative design issued into circulation at face value.

name: Collector banknote
definition: legal-tender note issued for collectors and not put into circulation.

name: Specimen note
definition: note printed as a specimen, proof, trial or pattern, or prepared and never issued.

name: Obsolete banknote
definition: note issued by a local or private bank, or of an issue that is no longer current, such as US obsolete currency and National Banknotes.

name: Facsimile or counterfeit note
definition: facsimile of a real note, a note of an issue that never existed, or a contemporary counterfeit.

name: Prop or souvenir note
definition: Note-like piece made as a film prop, demonstration note or souvenir and not legal tender.

name: Bullion bar
definition: cast or minted bar of precious metal sold by metal content and weight.

name: Bullion round
definition: coin-shaped piece of precious metal that is not legal tender, sold by metal content.

name: Bullion coin
definition: legal-tender coin struck in a mint's bullion programme in the standard bullion finish.

name: Transit and toll token
definition: token issued to pay one fare or toll on a transit system, road or bridge.

name: Locker and shopping cart token
definition: token issued to release a locker, shopping cart or similar deposit mechanism.

name: Trade token
definition: token issued by a merchant or private issuer to be exchanged for goods or a stated value.

name: Wage or ration token
definition: token issued to workers as wages or work tally, or as a ration entitlement.

name: Tax token
definition: token issued to pay sales tax or another tax in fractions of the smallest coin.

name: Emergency scrip
definition: Paper or other money issued to circulate as money by an issuer that is not a currency authority.

name: Definitive stamp
definition: everyday postage stamp of an ongoing series with no specific subject or issue code.

name: Commemorative stamp
definition: postage stamp issued for a limited period to mark an event, subject or season.

name: Souvenir sheet
definition: small sheet issued as a unit with one or more stamps and a decorated margin.

name: Stamp booklet
definition: folded booklet of stamps issued by a postal administration as one unit.

name: Stamped envelope
definition: envelope with a printed stamp issued by a postal administration.

name: Postal card
definition: postcard with a printed stamp issued by a postal administration.

name: First-day cover
definition: Cover carrying stamps cancelled on their day of issue, issued by a postal administration or prepared for the purpose.

name: Revenue stamp
definition: stamp issued to show payment of a tax or fee rather than postage.

name: Order, badge or star
definition: insignia of an order of chivalry or merit (badge, star, collar or sash badge).

name: Gallantry decoration
definition: decoration awarded for a specific act of gallantry or distinguished service.

name: Campaign medal
definition: medal awarded for service in a named campaign or operation.

name: Long-service medal
definition: medal awarded for a length of service or record of conduct.

name: Commemorative medal
definition: medal struck to mark an event, person or anniversary, such as a coronation, jubilee, birth or visit.

name: Art medal
definition: medal or plaquette struck or cast as a work of medallic art.

name: Souvenir medal
definition: souvenir piece struck or rolled for a place or event, including a coin rolled out with a new design.

name: Award medal
definition: Disc medal given for achievement in sport, school, military or other competition, finisher's medals included.

name: Challenge coin
definition: coin-shaped medal issued to members of a unit, club or organisation.

name: Mace
definition: ceremonial staff carried as insignia of a parliamentary, civic, academic or judicial office.

name: Gavel
definition: mallet used as insignia of a presiding office.

name: Trophy cup
definition: cup-shaped trophy on a base, perpetual cups included.

name: Award shield
definition: shield-shaped award, usually with plates for engraved names.

name: Award plaque
definition: flat award panel with an inscription, made to hang or stand.

name: Upright award
definition: column, figure, star, block or obelisk award on a base.

name: Bowl, tankard or salver
definition: bowl, tankard, tray or salver given as an award.

name: Rosette or ribbon
definition: rosette or ribbon given as an award.

name: Championship belt
definition: Belt awarded to a champion.

name: Championship ring
definition: Ring awarded to the members of a championship team or to a champion.

name: Base card
definition: standard card of a numbered sports or non-sports series issued by a card manufacturer.

name: Insert or autograph card
definition: Card inserted at a lower rate than the base set, including signed and relic cards.

name: Box card
definition: Card printed on the box, panel or packaging of another product and cut from it.

name: Collectible sticker
definition: Sticker from a numbered series, like Panini's, made to be collected into an album.

name: Sealed card product
definition: Unopened pack, box, blaster, hanger or case of cards.

name: Coin capsule or holder
definition: capsule, flip or holder made to hold one coin or note.

name: Grading slab
definition: sealed holder in which a grader encapsulates one coin, note or card.

name: Stamp hinge or mount
definition: hinge or clear mount made to fix one stamp in place.

name: Medal bar or ribbon bar
definition: bar on which medals or their ribbons are mounted for wear.

name: Medal ribbon
definition: length of ribbon made for one medal or decoration.

name: Medal case
definition: case made to hold one medal or decoration.

name: Card toploader or sleeve
definition: rigid toploader or soft sleeve made to hold one card.

name: Aerogram
definition: sheet or card with a printed stamp, issued by a postal administration, that folds and seals to form its own envelope; aerograms, letter sheets and lettercards.

name: Newspaper wrapper
definition: paper band with a printed stamp, issued by a postal administration, to wrap newspapers or printed matter for posting.

name: Philatelic numismatic cover
definition: cover issued by a postal administration that carries stamps cancelled for an issue together with a coin or medal mounted in it.

name: Vending machine token
definition: token issued to buy a product or a service from a coin-operated machine that is not a game, such as a dispenser, parking meter, car wash, laundry or telephone.

name: Coin weight
definition: weight made to check the weight of one coin denomination on a balance.

name: Admission or voting token
definition: token issued to admit the holder to a meeting, place or rite, to record attendance, or to cast a vote, communion tokens included.

name: Chain of office
definition: chain or collar worn as insignia of a civic or other office.

name: Crown of office
definition: Crown that is regalia of an office.
